description: Action with an empty-array member. Composition §6.3.2 specifies SHA-256(JCS(action)) — plain RFC 8785 — which retains empty arrays in the canonical form. CPB's Canonicalization Algorithm Registry carries only jcs-n, which removes empty-array members via the normalization pass (E3). The two constructions produce different bytes and different digests for the same action. The jcs-n digest is identical to diff-01 and diff-02 (all three normalize to the same two-member object); the plain-JCS digest is distinct from both, confirming that empty-array is an independent divergence source.
